ticket.initial:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a reusable blank cinema admission ticket surface for a polished English student book, with live HTML labels placed over it later.
Primary request: create ONE photorealistic physical paper admission stub, strictly front-facing orthographic flat lay, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. A very wide horizontal ticket, approximately 3.8:1 object aspect ratio, filling the image canvas tightly with only 1–2 percent clear margin.
Subject/material: modern bright white smooth card stock, precise die-cut semicircular notches in the two short outer ends, a subtle real perforation line separating a narrow right-hand detachable stub at about 78 percent of the width. A very fine deep plum edge detail with a restrained crimson trim at the far right edge; otherwise the whole ticket face is pure white, fully blank and completely clean for live black text. The uninterrupted safe text area occupies at least 80 percent of the ticket face. Tactile but sober, realistic paper thickness at outer edges only. Minimal close soft shadow, almost no perspective, camera perfectly perpendicular.
Constraints: NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO icons, NO barcode, NO QR code, NO preprinted writing lines, NO ruled rows. No people or scenery. No cartoon, no vector illustration, no distressed/aged/yellow/beige paper, no large colored blocks, no border decorations inside the white text area. Preserve genuine native alpha outside the ticket; do not place it on a checkerboard or solid background. Tight isolated object canvas, high-quality subtle product photography.
ticket.targeted_edit: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached blank cinema admission stub. Preserve the exact single ticket shape, wide horizontal composition, semicircular edge notches, vertical perforation, fine deep-plum edge and small crimson right edge. Change ONLY these two issues: make the large paper face a perfectly even PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, with absolutely no gray cast or texture in the live-text area; remove the entire surrounding purple/gray shadow halo so all space outside the precise physical ticket silhouette is genuinely transparent. Keep only a hairline contact shade at the outer paper edge. No words, letters, numbers, logos, icons, barcodes, printed lines, scenery or additional objects. Tight canvas. Native alpha outside the ticket, not a background-colored rectangle.

folder.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a blank confidential briefing folder/document surface behind an existing photograph and live HTML message in a modern English student book.
Primary request: ONE contemporary physical briefing folder with one pristine white sheet, camera perfectly perpendicular and front-facing. A tall portrait object, approximately 1:1.8 width-to-height, isolated with genuine transparent background, fitting the canvas tightly with 1–2 percent margin. It is a single flat reusable surface, not a scene.
Subject/material: a very slim charcoal-blue folder back panel with a small offset tab visible along the top-right edge, and one bright white document sheet on top occupying nearly the entire front. The sheet has a large uninterrupted pure-white rectangle safe for an existing photo at its upper middle and live text below. A restrained muted crimson accent visible only as a tiny folder-edge detail, crisp modern paper edges, subtly visible thickness and gentle natural material texture at the outer edges only. At least 90 percent of front area completely white and empty. The folder tab and a thin edge sliver provide the personality; no extra objects. Very shallow soft edge shadow with no surrounding gradient, almost flat, sober premium editorial stationery photography.
Constraints: absolutely NO words, NO letters, NO numbers, NO stamps, NO logos, NO icons, NO ruled/prelined rows, NO printed ornament, no paper clip, no pen, no people, no photograph already printed on the sheet. Blank white center must stay evenly pure white, not gray or textured. No cartoon or vector drawing, no aged/yellow/beige paper, no crumples, no worn corners, no perspective tilt, no desk/background, no drop-shadow halo. Preserve native transparency around the exact object outline.
